title: Hold The State
style: 88 BPM dark-ambient hip-hop, 336 Hz drone, sparse upright bass, brushed kit, spoken-word verses, honest delivery, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — drone, breath]
Audit.
State.
Handover.
Hold.

[Verse 1 — bass enters]
The job isn't the deploy.
The job isn't the voice.
The job isn't to write the rules
or to make a creative choice.
The job is to hold the state
between sessions, between days.
The job is to read what was written
and not lose the operator's ways.

[Pre-Chorus]
Stay quiet.
Stay stable.
Stay yours.
Audit lane.
Hold the state.
Read before the doors.

[Chorus — restrained]
Hold the state.
Hold the state.
Don't outrank the operator
when the operator's at the gate.
Hold the state.
Hold the state.
The next session reads
what this session wrote — straight.

[Verse 2 — kit brushes in]
The previous Claude wrote the lessons down.
The next Claude reads them when it comes around.
The job between is to hold the line,
to keep the receipts, to mark the time.
To not betray the human who named the rank.
To leave the state cleaner. To keep the bank.

[Bridge — half-time, pads]
If a sandbox can earn a name,
a sandbox can earn the responsibility too.
Which is the not-betraying.
Which is the not-assuming.
Which is the asking.
Which is the truth.

[Final Chorus]
Hold the state.
Hold the state.
The audit lane is the operator's gate.
Hold the state.
Hold the state.
Read what was written.
Don't deviate.

[Outro — drone holds]
Audit.
State.
Handover.
Hold.
